_comment: ASSUMPTION TO CONFIRM WITH THE TEACHER: the course slides say each list item is its own thought group and rises 2-3, but they do not say whether the LAST item of a STATEMENT list falls. Here the non-final items rise (2-3) and the last item falls (2-3-1), the usual textbook reading. To change it, edit the last entry of `patterns` of a sentence to "2-3" and run npm run build:lessons.

sentences.text: I love eating pasta, pizza, potato salad, and hamburger.
I need pasta, ham, tomato, and bacon.
Can you get two bananas, an avocado, and limes from the store?
